scores.label: Problem Understanding
scores.strengths: The proposal accurately identifies NordFrame's current setup across six warehouses and the operational visibility challenge it creates.
scores.weaknesses: In §1, the statement 'making real-time visibility difficult' only restates the high-level operational problem without exploring deeper business impacts or workflow constraints.

citations.quote: NordFrame's six warehouses currently rely on spreadsheets and a legacy system, making real-time visibility difficult.

scores.label: Scope & Deliverables Clarity
scores.strengths: Key platform capabilities and deployment strategy are clearly enumerated.
scores.weaknesses: The proposal does not define out-of-scope boundaries or specify concrete technical deliverables beyond high-level features in §2.

citations.quote: real-time inventory levels across all 6 warehouses, built on top of your existing PostgreSQL database

scores.label: Pricing Clarity
scores.strengths: The proposal offers an estimated total budget range for the deployment.
scores.weaknesses: In §4, Clarion provides only a wide price range without itemised cost breakdowns and defers firm pricing.

citations.quote: range from €70,000 to €110,000 depending on final integration complexity.

scores.label: Timeline Clarity
scores.strengths: The logical sequence of phases from discovery to rollout is identified.
scores.weaknesses: In §3, Clarion includes zero explicit dates or phase durations, stating instead that exact scheduling will be confirmed later.

citations.quote: We will begin with discovery and design, followed by a pilot phase

scores.label: Tone & Persuasiveness
scores.strengths: The proposal maintains a professional and clear tone while tailoring solution features specifically to warehouse and HQ operational roles.
scores.weaknesses: In §5, 'Clarion has delivered inventory and logistics dashboards for several mid-size distribution companies' remains generic without concrete metrics or specific evidence of past success.

citations.quote: Clarion has delivered inventory and logistics dashboards for several mid-size distribution companies across the DACH region.

scores.label: Risk/Assumptions Transparency
scores.weaknesses: The proposal fails to disclose any risks, dependencies, assumptions, or mitigations across any of its sections.

citations.quote: Exact scheduling will be confirmed once we begin discovery.

findings.proposalQuote: Exact scheduling will be confirmed once we begin discovery.
findings.explanation: Deferring schedule details leaves the client without any predictable milestones or commitment to delivery windows.
findings.fix: Specify concrete phase durations and target milestone dates such as [duration] for discovery and pilot phases.

findings.proposalQuote: We will provide a firm quote after discovery.
findings.explanation: Leaving the budget open to post-discovery confirmation prevents the client from assessing definitive financial commitments.
findings.fix: Provide a fixed fee or an itemized breakdown defining the scope covered by each cost tier.
